## 本次更新

- Windows 新增外接带屏 USB 音响歌词显示，保留音响上原有的字体与动画，并可在设置中开关。
- Windows 任务栏歌词等覆盖层改为嵌入任务栏，并自动避让任务栏图标、小组件与系统托盘区域，不再以全屏置顶浮窗遮挡内容。

## What's new

- Adds USB speaker screen lyrics on Windows, keeping the font and animation set on the speaker, with a switch in Settings.
- Embeds Windows taskbar overlays into the taskbar and automatically avoids taskbar icons, widgets, and the notification area instead of floating above everything.
